cases.exposure_context_quote: History taken with the relatives revealed the patient had taken half a glass of around 100 ml of insecticide thiamethoxam and lambda-cyclothrin in an alcohol-intoxicated state in the afternoon, after which he had intractable vomiting and became unconscious.
cases.agent: Thiamethoxam and lambda-cyhalothrin (neonicotinoid + pyrethroid insecticide combination), ~100 ml
cases.agent_quote: A 38-year-old male was brought to our hospital by his relatives ... History taken with the relatives revealed the patient had taken half a glass of around 100 ml of insecticide thiamethoxam and lambda-cyclothrin in an alcohol-intoxicated state in the afternoon
cases.circumstance: Suicide attempt: brought to hospital "after he had ingested this insecticide in an alcohol-intoxicated state to end his life"

symptoms.finding: partially rigid posture with gasping type of breathing; GCS 5/15; hypotension; SpO2 60% on room air
symptoms.quote: A 38-year-old male was brought to our hospital by his relatives in a partially rigid posture with a gasping type of breathing. His Glasgow coma scale (GCS) on admission was 5/15 E1V2M2 with a pulse rate of 100 per minute, blood pressure of 70/50 mmHg, oxygen saturation of 60% on room air, and a blood sugar level of 66 mg/dl.

symptoms.finding: generalized tonic-clonic seizure with uprolling of eyeballs, frothing, involuntary micturition en route
symptoms.quote: On the way to the hospital, the patient had thrown an episode of generalized tonic-clonic seizures with uprolling of the eyeballs, frothing from the mouth, and involuntary micturition in his clothes for a minute, after which his body went into a partially rigid state.

cases.time_to_care: UNVERIFIED (ingestion in the afternoon; exact interval to hospital arrival not stated)

labs.name: blood sugar
labs.quote: His Glasgow coma scale (GCS) on admission was 5/15 E1V2M2 with a pulse rate of 100 per minute, blood pressure of 70/50 mmHg, oxygen saturation of 60% on room air, and a blood sugar level of 66 mg/dl.

labs.name: arterial blood gas
labs.value: metabolic acidosis with bicarbonate deficit of 432 mmol
labs.quote: Arterial blood gas analysis of the patient upon arrival revealed metabolic acidosis with a bicarbonate deficit of 432 mmol.

treatment.name: endotracheal intubation and mechanical ventilation
treatment.quote: Given low GCS and hypoxia, immediate endotracheal intubation was done, and mechanical ventilator support was commenced.

treatment.name: fluid resuscitation and noradrenaline
treatment.quote: Adequate fluid resuscitation and Inj. Noradrenaline support at 8mg in 50 ml of normal saline (NS) at 3 ml/hr was started.

treatment.name: sodium bicarbonate
treatment.quote: An injection of bicarbonate (150 mEq IV stat f/b 150 mEq IV three times a day (TDS)

treatment.name: levetiracetam
treatment.quote: injection of levetiracetam (1 gm IV loading followed by 500mg IV twice a day (BD))

treatment.name: hydrocortisone
treatment.quote: injection of hydrocortisone (100mg IV stat followed by 100mg IV BD), and injection of pheniramine (2 mL IV stat) were also administered.

treatment.name: T-piece trial day 2, extubation day 3
treatment.quote: Supportive management was continued; the patient was weaned from the mechanical ventilator, and a T-piece trial was given on the second day, followed by extubation on the third day.

cases.icu_admission: UNVERIFIED (ventilated and sedated for one day; explicit ICU admission not stated)
cases.outcome: survived; weaned, extubated, shifted to ward, discharged after three further days of monitoring; follow-up uneventful
cases.outcome_quote: The patient was later shifted to the ward, and counseling sessions were undertaken by the psychiatrist. The patient was monitored for another three days and discharged. Follow-up has been uneventful.
cases.notes: Serum cholinesterase was sent but no result reported in text.
